fact_previews: The equestrian world currently lacks a centralized hub for connections, leading to missed opportunities for riders and small businesses.
The platform being developed includes a directory of equestrian businesses and professionals tailored to user needs and location.
The platform features a Knowledge Hub that provides articles, how-tos, and expert content for riders.
An Events Calendar is part of the platform, allowing users to discover and attend local shows, clinics, and gatherings.
The platform includes an Opportunity Board for collaborations, sponsorships, and unique growth opportunities in the equestrian space.
